text_block_list.text:
Training with Air Groove for the day was 
over, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You go on ahead back. From here 
on, this is my personal time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to thoroughly iron out every 
area of concern.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Or what? You got a problem with how I 
spend my time?"
choice_data_list: I want you to get plenty of rest, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Well, whatever. Do as you like. It's our 
personal time anyway."

Afterward, I stayed with Air Groove 
through to the end of her self-directed 
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand your intent, but... I am the 
one who understands my own condition best.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that, I'm moving forward because I 
believe I still can. Do not interfere with 
your needless remarks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you'll make a menu so 
intense it won't even leave them with 
enough energy for solo training?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fufu... So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Very well. If that is the case, I shall 
refrain from independent training today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You better have a new menu ready by next 
time.

After promising to design a training menu 
that reflected her input, we wrapped up 
our session for the day.
